hero.subtitle: A developer who loves frontend, design systems and clean code. I work with React and Angular, building complex forms, tables and filters. This site is a living portfolio: Feature-Sliced Design, design tokens, a micro UI-kit, i18n, tests and deployment via GitHub Actions.

about.title: The best frontend is built with best practices
about.text: Frontend for me is not only code, but also architecture, tests and attention to UI details. Everything in this project is real: a working design system, strict linting and architecture checks.
